_schema_comment: Each entry has the following fields:

_fields.type: One of: litigation | gao | ig | other. Required.
_fields.title: Short human-readable title of the finding or case. Required.
_fields.url: Canonical URL (court docket, GAO report, IG report). Required.
_fields.confirmed: true = manually verified match; false = lead only. Required.
_fields.added_by: Initials or name of curator who added this entry. Required.

_how_to_add: 1. Run gsa_gc_search_litigation to find candidate CourtListener cases.
2. Manually verify the case relates to the specific use case (name matches are often false positives).
3. Add a new JSON object below with confirmed: true only after verification.
4. Re-run scripts/build_index.py if risk scores need updating.
5. Never auto-populate this file from search results.

title: ACLU v. CBP — facial recognition deployment at border
summary: ACLU FOIA lawsuit seeking records on CBP's deployment of facial recognition technology at ports of entry and its impact on travelers' rights.
notes: Placeholder example entry to illustrate schema. use_case_id must be updated to match a real record_id from the inventory before this entry is used in scoring.
